attributes.text: Please take a moment to enter your California EBT website login information and create a quick login PIN#
Note: YOU MUST USE THE LOGIN INFO FROM YOUR California EBT WEB ACCOUNT in order to view your info with this app. If you do not already have one, go to https://www.ebt.ca.gov to set up an account.

Username and Password confirmed. Create an application PIN# to save your login information and secure access to it from this device. This number will automatically log you into your online EBT account using your stored login information.
